brand.name: VARA
brand.philosophy: VARA represents the intersection of timeless craftsmanship and modern cinematic elegance. It is not just a marketplace; it is an editorial journey. The brand voice is confident, quiet, and sophisticated—never shouting, only whispering luxury.

colors.instructions: NO saturated colors. NO default Tailwind blue/indigo. NO gradients. Use solid colors. The theme is strictly light-mode with high-contrast dark charcoal/black text.

headings.styles: Use font-light or font-normal. tracking-tighter for massive headers. Never use Inter for headings.

body.styles: tracking-wide for overlines. Clean, crisp legible body text.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[6rem] leading-none tracking-tighter
hierarchy.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-[#7A8164]

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol with high asymmetry. Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly. Use generous gaps (gap-8 to gap-16).
spacing_and_layout.instructions: Huge white space. Let the photography and typography breathe. Do NOT use Bootstrap-style 12-column equal grids. Optical alignment over mathematical alignment. Stagger items.

motion.scroll: MUST use 'lenis' for smooth scrolling to provide an Apple-like cinematic feel.

effects.parallax: Use Framer Motion's useScroll to create subtle y-axis parallax on large images.
effects.reveal: Mask reveal on scroll for typography. Elements should slide up gently with low opacity fading to 1.
effects.hover: Image zoom on hover (scale-105) within overflow-hidden containers. Soft lift (-translate-y-1) for product cards.
effects.magnetic: Implement a magnetic pull effect on primary CTA buttons if possible, otherwise slow ease-out transitions.

header.style: Transparent initially, turns solid (#F8F6F2) on scroll with backdrop-blur. Must contain Brand Name center, Links left/right, and icons (search, wishlist). NO transparent dropdowns.

hero.style: Immersive full-screen (min-h-screen). Massive serif typography. High-end lifestyle photography as background or side-by-side asymmetrical layout. Elegant CTA.

product_card.style: Cardless layout. Just the image container, then text below. Hover image swap (show secondary image on hover). Quick view button appears on hover. Price hierarchy: brand name small, product name serif, price sans-serif.

buttons.primary: bg-[#121212] text-[#F8F6F2] hover:bg-[#2D3B34] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 text-sm tracking-[0.1em] uppercase
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#121212] border border-[#121212] hover:bg-[#F5F2EC] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 text-sm tracking-[0.1em] uppercase

footer.style: Editorial, large typography. Massive 'VARA' text at the bottom. Newsletter signup inline. Minimal social links.

pages.home: Hero, Featured Collection (asymmetrical), Brand Story (text heavy, large serif, overlapping image), Best Sellers (carousel or stagger grid), Lifestyle showcase (parallax full width), Testimonials, Instagram gallery, Newsletter.
pages.product_detail: Split layout. Left: large sticky image gallery or continuous scroll. Right: Sticky product info, variant selection (minimal circles/boxes), 'Buy Now' affiliate button, accordion for specs/shipping.
pages.catalog: Minimal filters sidebar or top bar. 3 or 4 column grid with generous gaps.
pages.about: Magazine storytelling. Alternating left/right image and text. Large pull quotes. Timeline of craftsmanship.
pages.contact: Minimalist form. No standard inputs; use border-b only for inputs. Editorial store location image.

accessibility.aria_labels: Ensure all buttons, image swaps, and interactive elements have aria-labels.
accessibility.contrast: Always verify APCA contrast. Use text-[#121212] on #F8F6F2 backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to all interactive and key informational elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT create a generic Shopify-like layout. Rely heavily on white space, asymmetry, and massive serif typography.
Do NOT use typical card borders for products. Product grids should feel like an editorial magazine spread.
Create 16 premium demo products spread across the categories defined in the images section.
Use affiliate logic: Instead of a traditional cart checkout, use a 'Shop Now' / 'Buy Now' button on the product page that acts as an external redirect (can just log or alert for demo).
All components must be custom built with Tailwind, avoiding generic Shadcn card layouts for the storefront. Shadcn can be used for forms/accordions but MUST be stripped of the default Vercel-look.
Ensure `data-testid` attributes are added across the application.
Make sure to design the mobile experience specifically—do NOT just stack columns. Redesign layouts for touch (horizontal scroll snapping, full-screen mobile menu).
Ensure the hero image is completely uninhibited. Use minimal overlays. Typography should provide contrast naturally or with subtle text-shadow.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com, etc.). Only use the images provided in this JSON.
Ensure proper semantic HTML structure (header, main, section, article, footer).
